request:
I run a small provisions shop in Madina and I want to keep my price list on the computer instead of in my notebook. I want to add the things I sell with their prices. I want to see everything I sell, and look up the price of one thing. Sometimes I stop selling something, so I want to take it off the list.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: When a price goes up or down, do you want to change the price of an item already on the list, or will you remove it and add it again?
A: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
Q: Do some items have more than one price, like one tin versus a whole carton, or one sachet versus a pack?
A: No preference: you decide.
Q: When you look up a price, should typing part of the name (like "milo") show all matching items, or will you always type the full exact name?
A: No preference: you decide.

Where the client has no preference or did not answer, choose the simplest option and add nothing they did not ask for (no logins, PINs or extra required fields).
summary:
Your price list is ready, and all my checks on it passed.

**What you can do:**
- Add an item with its name and price.
- See every item you sell, in A–Z order.
- Look up the price of one item.
- Change an item's price when it goes up or down.
- Take an item off the list when you stop selling it.

**Choices I made for you:**
- Each item has one price. If you sell a tin and a carton at different prices, add them as two items, such as "Milo tin" and "Milo carton".
- To look up, change or remove an item, type its full name. Capital letters don't matter, so "sugar" finds "Sugar". Typing part of a name won't find it.
- Prices are kept to two places after the point, like 45.50 cedis.

**What it refuses:**
- An item with the same name as one already on the list.
- An item with a blank name.
- A price of zero or less, or no price at all.

It has only been tested on this computer.
